# M3 results: text-derived signals (auto-generated by src/event_study_text.py) — PRELIMINARY

MFA series come from the T+B1 classifier (macro-F1 0.859, κ 0.758 on 189 held-out sentences vs. a second, independent AI annotator; see reports/classifier_metrics.md). Labels come from two AI annotators (inter-annotator κ 0.935); **no human-annotated validation yet** (a human spot-check of 40 sentences is planned). MFA website boilerplate (exit-site popup, copyright footer; 288 rows) is excluded from the corpus.

Coverage: mfa_threat_share: 2022-07-19→2026-10-19 (763 days); mnd_aircraft: 2020-09-16→2026-10-19 (1368 days); mnd_ships: 2022-11-13→2026-10-19 (1025 days)
